summary: Map It, Move It! holds as a 5-day arc. Foundational four clear: Grade-1 traps with diagnostic-branched recovery; E1.1-E1.5 verbatim with named activities; everyday materials and L5 no-paper variant; Tig and Coco anchor with refrains threaded D1-D5. Arc coherence, code coverage, capstone (explicit D1-D4 station recap before the egocentric trap), vocabulary progression, character continuity all 4. Math authenticity 3: L4 lacks invent/compare and research citations though L1, L2, L5 cite Piaget-Inhelder, Battista, Clements-Sarama. One arc 3, all foundational 4 — pass.
